description: How sensitive the chart is to the recorded birth time, in plain language: minutes earlier or later until the rising sign changes, the same for the Moon nakshatra quarter (pada) and the D9 and D10 rising signs, and how many days the life chapter dates move per minute of birth time. It does not correct the birth time. Birth details are used only to calculate this answer and are not stored.

birth_time.description: Local birth time as recorded, 24-hour HH:MM or HH:MM:SS.

name: birth_time_check
title: Birth time sensitivity
